650c421bc597fb311e7a82b6e96003c7.overview: Ruthless silver miner, turned oil prospector, Daniel Plainview, moves to oil-rich California. Using his son to project a trustworthy, family-man image, Plainview cons local landowners into selling him their valuable properties for a pittance. However, local preacher Eli Sunday suspects Plainview's motives and intentions, starting a slow-burning feud that threatens both their lives.
650c421bc597fb311e7a82b6e96003c7.tagline: There will be greed. There will be vengeance.

651a5308840f64178e6d145dbedbcdae.overview: Set in 1929, a political boss and his advisor have a parting of the ways when they both fall for the same woman.

6529a699d5fe056560a1c391888bdf22.overview: Sheik Ahmed desperately desires feisty British socialite Diana, so he abducts her and carries her off to his luxurious tent-palace in the desert. The free-spirited Diana recoils from his passionate embraces and yearns to be released. Later, allowed to go into the desert, she escapes and makes her way across the sands...
6529a699d5fe056560a1c391888bdf22.tagline: A photoplay of tempestuous love between a madcap English beauty and a bronzed Arab chief!

65604be584e8d4af15b426ae1a148c9f.overview: After the death of a septuagenarian woman, her three children deliberate over what to do with her estate.

65a5654a367cb907b8291f3947282a1c.overview: After a band of drunken thugs overruns a small Indian Nation town, killing Reverend Goodnight and raping the women folk, Eula Goodnight enlists the aid of US Marshal Cogburn to hunt them down and bring her father's killers to justice.
65a5654a367cb907b8291f3947282a1c.tagline: The man of "True Grit" is back and look who's got him!

65b1ebb6200b50d5d9ae23d80a90ac83.overview: A roustabout joins a traveling carny and schemes to figure out the mind-reading act of Mademoiselle Zeena and her alcoholic husband.
65b1ebb6200b50d5d9ae23d80a90ac83.tagline: He was all things to all men… But only one thing to all women!

65b2dfbf123a8641ea567c3dbb008d39.overview: Middle-aged Giulietta grows suspicious of her husband, Giorgio, when his behavior grows increasingly questionable. One night when Giorgio initiates a seance amongst his friends, Giulietta gets in touch with spirits and learns more about herself and her painful past. Slightly skeptical, but intrigued, she visits a mystic who gives her more information -- and nudges her toward the realization that her husband is indeed a philanderer.
65b2dfbf123a8641ea567c3dbb008d39.tagline: The inhibitions... the desires... the obsessions... of a jealous woman held prisoner by her own dreams
